2026-11-05.patch_summary: This patch fixes a bug in the Btrfs file system where cloned files would always update their creation and modification times, even when FMODE_NOCMTIME was set. This is problematic because it allows a client to advance the server's ctime during a CLONE operation, which can cause issues with delegated timestamps. The patch makes btrfs_clone_files() respect FMODE_NOCMTIME by passing no_time_update for destinations that have this flag set. Additionally, it exposes the btrfs_should_update_cmtime() function to reflink.c so that it can be used in other contexts.
